components.name: proposition
values: scdca utilizes less than 1% of the parameters required by naive fine-tuning resulting in a faster and more memory-efficient procedure.

components.name: proposition
values: scdca consistently outperforms naive fine-tuning of scgpt across all tasks with the performance gap widening for more challenging tasks such as few-shot and zero-shot settings.

components.name: proposition
values: scdca outperforms all baseline methods chemcpa biolord sams-vae across all tasks with particularly notable improvements in unseen cell line prediction zero-shot and few-shot .

components.name: method
values: biolord | deep generative framework for disentangled representations in single-cell data partitioning latent space into subspaces for cell lines and perturbations.
chemcpa | encoder-decoder architecture with separate embeddings for molecule and cell line using an adversarial classifier for invariant basal states.
sams-vae | sparse additive mechanism shift variational autoencoder employing additive conditioning for perturbation prediction.

scdca | single-cell drug-conditional adapter efficient fine-tuning of a single-cell foundation model scgpt by training less than 1% of the original model parameters via a drug-conditional adapter module that incorporates molecular structure information while keeping the fm weights frozen.
scgpt fine-tuning naive | standard fine-tuning of scgpt by training all or most parameters on the perturbation prediction task.
